::: {.section-head}
About the seminar
:::

Our aim is to bring together speakers from our community and industry to
highlight remarkable scientific advances and research enabled by AI and
novel data. We are particularly interested in the exciting work being done
on Stanford's GPU cluster,
[Marlowe](https://datascience.stanford.edu/marlowe). Our goal is to
communicate this research and share ideas that may be useful to a broad
community of researchers.

The seminar is open to the Stanford community, and meets Wednesdays at
4:30 pm in [CoDA E160](https://campus-map.stanford.edu/?srch=CoDA).
Students may enroll under any of the cross-listed course numbers —
[STATS 282](https://explorecourses.stanford.edu/search?view=catalog&q=STATS+282),
EE 292R, or PSYCH 292R — via [Axess](https://axess.stanford.edu).
